svg.title: Flat wooden toboggan deck, side view, facing right. Boards and two battens, no runners: a toboggan is a flat plank and a sled on runners is a different object, which is the distinction assets/style/quebec-city-level.md 7 draws for the lane markings and this part has to draw for the rider. It runs 24 px BEHIND the rider’s back so a tail of plank is visible past the coat at phone size - without it the sled is a line under a seated person. The rider sits ON it, so it draws behind the legs; the curled prow is a separate part, `mount-fore`, because it has to draw in FRONT of the shins folded over it.
